decisionsTitle: «Elită — doar numele pe BIB»: a race's elite runners printed by name, a list beside the registrations and never in them
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03:** a race's elite runners get race numbers with their **name where the number usually is**, printed from a list of names — not from registrations. Asked where such names live, he chose **«Listă separată»** (a list of its own, beside the registrations), and of what an elite bib carries besides the name: «toate acestea sunt configurabile» — the number and the sponsors' band are the club's to switch.

**Decision.**

- **A list of names per event**, «Elită — doar numele pe BIB», a closed fold of «Alocare și tipărire» beside the desk's spares (§444), drawn only where the spares are: an event that takes registrations here, for a role that reads the bibs. Its closed line says how many (`countForm`). Each line is a **name** — trimmed, inner spaces collapsed, 1 to 80 characters — and an **optional number**, a whole number from 1 to 99 999 that is nobody else's at the race (below). Nothing else: no address, no telephone, no date of birth, no consent. Table `event_elite_entries` (migration 0183, expand only), deleted with its event — and **three years after the race at the latest**, with the race's registrations and its typed result names (§808; `jobs/retention.ts`, step `event-elite-entries`): the names are real people's, and the event's own row stays for the listing.
- **Not registrations.** No participant, no place, no queue, no state, no email, no declaration. Nothing that counts or lists registrations reads the table — the places and the allocator, «Locuri», the kits, the registrations' summary and export, the sponsors' list, the race-day desk, the results, the emails, the ordinary bib sheet; the one thing of it the race numbers read is a line's number, as taken (below). A test holds `countOccupied`, `countKits`, `summariseRegistrationsForAdmin`, `readPlaceOutlook`, `countBibs` and `listBibs` unchanged by five elite lines, and no registration or participant row made. **The declaration rule is untouched** (CLAUDE.md's table, `AGENTS.md` §10.8): there is still no registration without the person's own approved declaration — an elite line is a name to print and nothing else. An elite runner who also wants a place in the race registers like anybody.
- **A number is one person's** (the review, 2026-11-03). «Clasament» is keyed by race number, so two people wearing one number on race day is what this prevents, both ways. A typed number is refused — «Numărul acesta e deja folosit la eveniment…» on «Număr (opțional)» (`ELITE_NUMBER_TAKEN`), what was typed kept, nothing written — when a registration of the event has it (a cancelled one's included), had it (erased or replaced by hand, §311, §548), another elite line carries it, or it is one of the desk's reserved spares (§444: printed blank for a walk-in). The other way round, `bibs.ts#wornNumbers` reads the elite numbers as worn, so a confirmation's draw, «Alocă numerele», the desk's box and its suggestions and a print of spares never hand one out; deleting the line frees its number. The check runs under the event row's lock, the one every draw takes (`AGENTS.md` §10.6), so a confirmation cannot reach the number between the check and the insert. A number is held whether or not «Număr pe BIB-urile de elită» is ticked: the tick can change after the sheet is printed. An elite runner who also registered wears the registration's number, which their elite line cannot repeat. The card's help says it: «Doar un număr liber, care apoi nu se mai dă nimănui.»
- **Who.** The Organizer and above read the list, its sample and its sheet (`canReadRegistrations`, the bibs' own rule, §289); the Administrator adds and deletes (`canManageRegistrations`), asserted at the door of `addEliteEntryAction` and `deleteEliteEntryAction` and again in `elite-list.ts` (BR-REQ-060-01); Tehnic and the volunteer see nothing. The delete asks first, naming the person (§384); the add asks nothing — it writes a name, nobody is told, and the delete undoes it. The card stands inside the event's save form, so its boxes and buttons name forms beside it (the detached form of §763 for the add, one small asked form per line for the delete): «Salvează» never posts a name, and a refused add keeps what was typed. Both presses land back on the card with it and every fold around it open: the redirect carries `?saved=eliteAdded` or `eliteDeleted` and the page opens «Participare, înscrieri și regulament», «Numere de concurs (BIB)», «Alocare și tipărire» and the elite fold from it (`openWhen.saved`, as the queue's «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» does, §872), because a redirect to the same page is a soft navigation the hash opener (`OpenFoldFromHash`, §336) never sees — the browser run found the folds closed after the add; `#bib-elite` only scrolls. The trail — `event_elite.added`, `event_elite.deleted`, entity `event` — holds the line's id only, never the name or its number.
- **The bib.** The race's header as on every bib; where the big number goes, the **name**, bold, as large as the number's area and the card's width allow, up to 110 points times «Mărimea cifrelor»: on **one line** while one line reaches 48 points — a name reads best unbroken — else on **two**, split at a space where the name comes out largest; shrunk to fit, **never cut**, never a word broken. No name line under it, no blank mark, never the members' design. The number, when shown, sits **under** the name, 40 points bold, centred with it as one block: the name stays what is read at distance and the number reads as its caption — beside it, it would take the name's width. The route's profile, the emergency phone and the small print as on any bib. Laid out once (`bib-geometry.ts#bibEliteLayout`, measured with Roboto Bold's table, never narrower than pdfkit or Satori sets a line) and drawn by the sheet and the picture alike (`bibs-pdf.ts`, `bib-image.tsx`); what an elite bib carries is decided once in `bib-elite.ts`.
- **Two settings of the design**, in «Cum arată numărul de concurs» → «Elită», tick boxes with their help, both **off by default** — an absent key reads off, so every stored design prints as it did: «Număr pe BIB-urile de elită» (`eliteNumber`: the line's number under the name, only when the line has one) and «Banda de sponsori pe BIB-urile de elită» (`eliteSponsors`: the sponsors' row, its stubs only with a number to repeat). Both travel in the event's JSON file like every key of the design; the list of names does not.
- **The sheet**: `GET /api/admin/events/<id>/bibs?elite=1` — every line in the order typed, two A5 bibs to an A4 page or one per page, `-elite` in the file's name; no range, part or «unprinted» applies. The card's sample is the preview route's `elite=1`, drawn with the saved design and a placeholder name — never a name from the list — and stamped with the saved checkpoints (`v=`) as the designer's own sample is, so a changed strip of checkpoints is never an hour-old cached picture.
- **Seen in a browser** (`tests/e2e/elite-bibs.spec.ts`, at 320 px and on a desktop), because the card's forms are what a unit test cannot see: the add is a detached form wrapped around the event's save form, each delete a hidden asked-first form a button submits through `form=`. The Administrator adds a name and a number and lands on the card with it and the folds around it open and the toast; is refused a number already on the list, both boxes kept; presses «Salvează» on the event with the card's required name box empty and a number typed beside it, and the save goes through with no line posted or doubled; deletes through the dialog that names the person. The Organizer sees the list and its sheet, no add box and no delete.

**Refused.**

- **An elite runner as a registration without a declaration** — a kind of registration, or a staff entry, that skips the signature. It would break the rule that no registration exists without the person's own approved declaration, and it would put the elite runners into every count the club reads.
- **A staff-signed declaration** for an elite runner. The declaration is the person's: staff record a paper one the participant signed, never sign one (`AGENTS.md` §15.11).
changelogLine: - **«Elită» on the race numbers** — a list of the race's elite runners under «Alocare și tipărire», printed as bibs with the name where the number goes (`bibs?elite=1`); the number and the sponsors' band only when ticked in «Cum arată numărul de concurs» → «Elită». Names, not registrations: no place, no email, no count. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event that takes registrations here, when an Administrator writes a name (1 to 80 characters, inner spaces collapsed) and an optional number (1 to 99999) on «Elită — doar numele pe BIB», then the sheet `bibs?elite=1` prints one bib per name — the race's header, the name where the number goes on one line or two, shrunk to fit and never cut, no name line and no blank mark, the number under it only with «Număr pe BIB-urile de elită» ticked and the line's number set, the sponsors' band only with «Banda de sponsori pe BIB-urile de elită» ticked, both off by default — in a file named `…-elite.pdf`, for the Organizer and the Administrators. Verification: unit `registrations/elite-bibs.test.ts`, integration `registrations/elite-bibs-route.test.ts`, e2e `elite-bibs.spec.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given elite lines on an event, then no registration, participant or email exists for them, and the places, «Locuri», the kits, the registrations' summary and the bib sheet count exactly as without them; only an Administrator adds or deletes a line (the delete asked first), the Organizer reads, Tehnic sees nothing, and each write leaves an audit row naming the line's id only; «Salvează» on the event posts nothing of the list. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-list.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-actions.test.ts`, e2e `elite-bibs.spec.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an elite line's number, then it is nobody else's at the race: a number a registration of the event has or had (erased or replaced included), another elite line's, or one of the desk's reserved spares is refused on «Număr (opțional)» with nothing written, and no confirmation, «Alocă numerele», desk entry or print of spares gives a runner a number an elite line carries until the line is deleted. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-list.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-actions.test.ts`, e2e `elite-bibs.spec.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race whose start is more than three years past, when the retention sweep runs, then its elite lines are deleted with its registrations (step `event-elite-entries`), and a race younger than that keeps its list. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-list.test.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Elită» — named bibs for the race's elite runners, not registrations
